---
title: "Playground cutover packet"
description: "Worker identity, bindings, build, acceptance, rollback and smoke checks for publishing the native Playground Worker."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

Playground (`apps/playground`) runs on TanStack Start, Vite+ and Void through
the [start bridge](/build/devops/start-bridge). It is a staff-only surface; the
behaviour it must keep is recorded in the
[isolation contract](/build/devops/playground-isolation-contract). The emitted
Worker builds and passes its workerd suite, so source needs no change to
publish. Routes are never attached from config.

## Worker identity

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | `tuturuuu-playground` (production profile), `tuturuuu-playground-vite-staging` (default) |
| Profile selector | `VITE_PLAYGROUND_NATIVE_PROFILE=production` at build time |
| Hosts | `playground.tuturuuu.com`, `playground.tutur3u.com`, and the `tuturuuu.com/playground` mount; any other host is rejected |
| Compatibility | `nodejs_compat`, `global_fetch_strictly_public`; `workers_dev` and `preview_urls` off |
| Binding | `ASSETS` |
| Variables | `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX` (`0` in production), `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_APP_URL`, optional `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` |
| Secrets (names) | `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` |

`cloudflare/startup.mjs` refuses to serve when a secret is empty or when the
coordination secret is the development value.

## Build

```bash
bun turbo:local run build --filter='@tuturuuu/playground^...' --concurrency=2
bun run --silent scripts/ci/generate-build-metadata.ts
VITE_PLAYGROUND_NATIVE_PROFILE=production bun run --cwd apps/playground build
CI=true CI_SOURCE_SHA=<sha> bun run --cwd apps/playground test:runtime
```

`playground-cloudflare.yaml` runs the same steps and seals the output with
`scripts/ci/playground-native-artifact.py` in its `cutover-artifact` job. Run the
build on a CI or remote runner, not a developer machine.

## Acceptance covered by `test:runtime`

- the emitted Worker verifies a staff session before it renders any private page
- AI routes answer `401` signed out and `403` for non-staff or non-root members
- every response carries `X-Robots-Tag`; `robots.txt` disallows all crawling
- no execution, iframe or sandbox surface exists in the app

The root layout loads Geist through `next/font/google`; the RSC plugin resolver
handles it and the build succeeds. Compare rendered fonts on the staging host
before the switch, since that is a visual check the suite does not cover.

## Rollback

Capture the current Vercel deployment ID before the switch. Remove or repoint the
prepared Worker route, or restore the captured DNS, to that deployment. Route
rollback does not touch data.

## Smoke checks

Pages are staff-only, so an anonymous `200` is not expected on `/`.

- signed-out `GET /` redirects to the Web sign-in page with a return URL
- `/api/build-info` answers `200` JSON
- `/api/ai/object-generation` answers `401` signed out
- `/robots.txt` disallows all crawling
- no `5xx` across the above
